answers.core: It could be provided as a static library for godot-cpp authors - and that's how I use it, since I implemented it myself. It should be made core if the core team feels it aligns with, and helps achieve, the direction and end goals they have for godot-cpp.
answers.workaround: Workarounds are not needed. The enhancement adds an optional abstraction layer between binding code and ClassDB - the existing ClassDB API is completely unaffected.

title: Add type-safe, low-boilerplate bindings for godot-cpp
